0.0: Hello, #h0#. How go your adventures? You've always got a career waiting for you here if it gets too hard. Well, shall we begin?

yes.0: Let's begin our ninth class. Today, you will learn the cheering expression. Few expressions contain the feeling and warmth of the cheering expression. You need to make people genuinely happy to see you.
yes.1: Do you know a girl named #b#p2012007##k in #b#m200000000##k? She works at the hair salon, and she constantly strives to create better styles. If you give her #b#t1162003##k, she will give you the most cheering expression you've ever seen.
yes.2: Scissorhands can't be found in Orbis. I hear they're for sale in Henesys, though. Good luck.

no.0: Is your adventuring really more important than acting?

npc.0: Did you see #b#p2012007##k yet? She's in #m200000202#.
